profile.text: Haruka, born Haruka Shino, is a well-known entertainer in the Southern Court of Higashi, performing under the stage name Momoka Hanyuu. She was recommended to Rhodes Island by Operator Hoshiguma and acts as liaison between Rhodes Island and Higashi. She is being assigned to a number of field missions at her own request.
